linked_prs.title: refactor data packing and fix loss scale.
linked_prs.body:
1. 可读性提升，data packing和ring_attn的相关代码只限制在Actor forward内
2. packing情况下loss计算与非packing一致，既考虑了sample级别的loss（PolicyLoss等forward），也考虑到了action mask的scale（masked_mean）
  a. 之前packing情况下，packing的多个sample的所有token loss统一做一次mean，短序列的重要性会被压制
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ba179766-aba6-42e8-af12-f6dcfdedf46b)

  b. 当前packing，传入action_mask不为None，每个sample内所有token单独先mean，sample间再mean，且masked_mean中会对loss做action_mask的scale
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e844a651-ccc0-4407-bf13-4238daf29a36)

issues.title: 多机多卡下开启vllm engine会卡住
issues.body:
## 环境
环境采用的是readme提到的dockerfile，和pip install 的安装方式。显卡是**2机16卡**的A800， 目前的情况是在2机16卡下开了vllm engine以后就会直接卡住。
几个比较重要的包：
torch: 2.3.0+cu121
ray: 2.12.0
vllm: 0.4.2

## 目前表现
1. 目前不用ray的脚本，采用torchrun的方式, 2机16卡下面可以跑通.
2. 用ray的脚本，比如`examples/scripts/train_ppo_llama_ray.sh`，在2机16卡的情况下，把`vllm_num_engines`设置为0，可以跑通
3. 用ray的脚本，比如`examples/scripts/train_ppo_llama_ray.sh`， 在**单机8卡**下面可以跑通。
-  只在单机上运行ray start --head --node-ip-address 0.0.0.0 --num-gpus 8
-  修改以下配置
```
   --ref_num_nodes 1 \
   --ref_num_gpus_per_node 2 \
   --reward_num_nodes 1 \
   --reward_num_gpus_per_node 2 \
   --critic_num_nodes 1 \
   --critic_num_gpus_per_node 2 \
   --actor_num_nodes 1 \
   --actor_num_gpus_per_node 2 \
   --vllm_num_engines 4 \
   --vllm_tensor_parallel_size 1 \
```
4. 在2机16卡上，设置了`vllm_num_engine`以后，会直接卡住

-   在master节点上运行`ray start --head --node-ip-address 0.0.0.0 --num-gpus 8`, 在worker节点上运行`ray start --address ${MASTER_ADDR}:6379  --num-gpus 8`
-   修改配置为
```
ray job submit --address="http://127.0.0.1:8265" \
   --runtime-env-json='{"working_dir": "/path/to/OpenRLHF"}' \
   -- python3 -m openrlhf.cli.train_ppo_ray \
   --ref_num_nodes 1 \
   --ref_num_gpus_per_node 4 \
   --reward_num_nodes 1 \
   --reward_num_gpus_per_node 4 \
   --critic_num_nodes 1 \
   --critic_num_gpus_per_node 4 \
   --actor_num_nodes 1 \
   --actor_num_gpus_per_node 4 \
   --vllm_num_engines 8 \
   --vllm_tensor_parallel_size 1 \
   ...
```
3) 发现代码会直接卡住。

## 尝试定位bug
1. 首先怀疑是vllm的问题
于是在2机16卡上跑了一下`openrlhf/trainer/ray/vllm_engine.py`,  设置了TP为16， 发现是可以跑通的
```
if __name__ == "__main__":
    llm = LLMRayActor.remote("/path/to/Meta-Llama-3-8B-hf/", tensor_parallel_size=16)
    output = ray.get(llm.generate.remote("San Franciso is a"))
    print(f"output: {output}")
```

2. 尝试定位程序是卡在了哪里，在自己加入了log信息以后，发现程序卡在了[ppo_actor.py](https://github.com/OpenRLHF/OpenRLHF/blob/685a9605580d1149b4763aefe5b26b7c84ced4df/openrlhf/trainer/ray/ppo_actor.py#L94-L113)下面，
```python
            refs = [
                engine.init_process_group.remote(
                    master_address,
                    master_port,
                    i * vllm_tensor_parallel_size + 1,
                    world_size,
                    "openrlhf",
                    backend=backend,
                )
                for i, engine in enumerate(self.vllm_engines)
            ]
            ...
            ray.get(refs)
```
这里的ray在获取返回结果的时候就直接卡住了， 请问作者有什么比较好的思路吗？ 或者需要我提供什么额外的信息来帮忙定位bug吗？

linked_prs.title: Add support for vLLM weight sync with Ray collective communication
linked_prs.body:
Can be an alternative to / aside from #680 and fix #492, as in Ray collective communication lib, setting master addr/port is not needed.

Current torch vLLM weight sync implementation with NCCL sometimes causes hang, especially on AMD GPUs, this PR tries to address this issue by using Ray collective communication lib, so that we can benefit from the blazing fast NCCL (RCCL on AMD) smoothly.

https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/ray-more-libs/ray-collective.html

Note that Ray CC lib would need cupy for NCCL backend.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves the behavior of the `vllm engine` and its integration with Ray, which is tied to LLM provider usage and tool invocation. The problem occurs during the initialization of processes in a distributed setup, which aligns with agent workflow and tool-related issues.
